snippet.title: The Citadel Project - Official Demo release trailer
snippet.description:
Official demo release trailer for The Citadel Project, a solo-developed FPS stealth game. Demo coming around mid September 2026 on Steam.

Wishlist on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4795460/The_Citadel_Project/

Follow game update on X : https://x.com/CitadelPrxject

Credits:
Music: Horror Cello by Soundridemusic
Link to Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fhVWDc1Zawo
